definitions.explanation: Having a curved shape like a circle or ball.

examples.japanese: {丸|まる}いテーブルがあります。
{丸|まる}い{顔|かお}をしている。

notes:
{丸|まる}い is an i-adjective meaning round, circular, or spherical.

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {丸|まる}い: most common
- {円|まる}い: alternative kanji

FORMS:
- {丸|まる}い: round (basic form)
- {丸|まる}く: roundly (adverb)
- {丸|まる}さ: roundness (noun)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {丸|まる}い{顔|かお}: round face
- {丸|まる}いテーブル: round table
- {丸|まる}い{目|め}: round eyes
- {丸|まる}くなる: to become round

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {丸|まる}く{収|おさ}まる: to be settled peacefully
- {角|かど}が{取|と}れて{丸|まる}くなる: to become mellow (personality)

OPPOSITE SHAPES:
- {四角|しかく}い: square
- {三角|さんかく}の: triangular
